evidence.notes: Decimal.format groups thousands and formats the numeric value without retaining insignificant trailing zeroes.

source.content: System.assertEquals('999', Decimal.valueOf('999.0').format()); System.assertEquals('1', Decimal.valueOf('1.00').format()); System.assertEquals('10,000.5', Decimal.valueOf('10000.50').format());
